```{=html}
<div class="cx" id="cx-explorer">

      <div class="x-eyebrow">Explorer · Immune checkpoint therapy patents · 1997–2023</div>
      <h1>China's share of immune checkpoint patents nearly doubled in five years</h1>
      <p class="x-lede">Who files patents on PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4 and newer checkpoint targets, where they seek protection, and what they protect. Explore 3,320 patent documents from Lens.org, exported in January 2024.</p>
      <div class="x-kpis" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="x-kpi"><div class="x-v x-accent" id="k1">–</div><div class="x-l">of documents had a Chinese applicant in 2020–21</div><div class="x-n" id="k1n"></div></div>

    </div>
  </header>

  <nav class="x-bar" aria-label="Filters">

      <label>From <select id="y0" aria-label="First application year"></select></label>

      <label>Target <select id="ft" class="x-wide-sel" aria-label="Checkpoint target"></select></label>
      <label>Strategy <select id="fg" class="x-wide-sel" aria-label="Strategy"></select></label>

  <div class="x-wrap" style="padding:8px 0 8px">

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">1 · Growth</div><h2>Filing grew fast after 2014</h2>
      <p>Most documents are still pending applications. Shaded years are incomplete: patents are published about 18 months after filing.</p></div>
    <section class="x-card x-wide">
      <h2 id="h1t">Patent documents by application year and legal status</h2>

      <div class="x-cap" id="cap1"></div>

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">2 · Who files</div><h2>Large US firms lead; universities and hospitals are a growing share</h2>

      </section>
      <section class="x-card">

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">3 · Where applicants are based</div><h2>The United States and China file most; China is catching up</h2>
      <p>Applicant country as recorded on the patent. A document with applicants from two countries counts once for each.</p></div>
    <div class="x-grid">

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">4 · What is protected</div><h2>PD-1 and PD-L1 dominate; newer targets are still small</h2>
      <p>Targets and strategies are keyword labels on titles and abstracts, so treat them as indicative. A document can carry several labels.</p></div>

      <h2>Documents per checkpoint target and year</h2>

      </section>
      <section class="x-card">
        <h2>Topics found by topic modelling</h2><p class="x-sub">From the 2024 analysis (BERTopic on titles and abstracts).</p>
        <div id="c8" class="x-chart x-tall" role="img" aria-label="Topics"></div><div class="x-cap" id="cap8"></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">5 · Where protection is sought</div><h2>China, the PCT route and the US receive most filings</h2>
      <p>Filing offices show target markets, not where inventors work. WIPO stands for the international PCT route.</p></div>
    <div class="x-grid">
      <section class="x-card">
        <h2>Documents by filing office</h2>
        <div id="c9" class="x-chart x-tall" role="img" aria-label="Documents by filing office"></div><div class="x-cap" id="cap9"></div>
      </section>
      <section class="x-card">
        <h2>Top 8 offices by year</h2>
        <div id="c10" class="x-chart x-tall" role="img" aria-label="Offices by year"></div><div class="x-cap" id="cap10"></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">6 · Links to science</div><h2>Nearly half of the documents cite research papers</h2>
      <p>Citing papers shows a patent's link to science; being cited by later patents shows its influence on later inventions.</p></div>
    <div class="x-grid">
      <section class="x-card">
        <h2>Share of documents citing research papers</h2><p class="x-sub">From 2014. Older documents have had more time to collect citations.</p>
        <div id="c11" class="x-chart" role="img" aria-label="Share citing papers"></div><div class="x-cap" id="cap11"></div>
      </section>
      <section class="x-card">
        <h2>Documents by number of papers cited</h2>
        <div id="c12" class="x-chart" role="img" aria-label="Papers cited"></div><div class="x-cap" id="cap12"></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div class="x-sec"><div class="x-tag">7 · Look up</div><h2>Search organisations, countries, inventors and patents</h2>
      <p>Tables follow your filters. Click a column to sort. Names link to Lens.org.</p></div>
    <section class="x-card x-wide">
      <div class="x-seg" role="group" aria-label="Table">
        <button type="button" data-t="orgs" aria-pressed="true">Organisations</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="ctys" aria-pressed="false">Countries</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="invs" aria-pressed="false">Inventors</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="pats" aria-pressed="false">Most-cited patents</button>
      </div>
      <div class="x-warn" id="inv-warn" hidden>Inventor names are not disambiguated. Common names may merge several different people, so treat this list as indicative.</div>
      <div class="x-tbl-tools"><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search this table" aria-label="Search this table"><button type="button" id="csv">⬇ Download this table (CSV)</button></div>
      <div class="x-tbl-wrap"><table class="x-tbl" id="tbl"></table></div>
      <div class="x-pager"><button type="button" id="prev">Previous</button><span id="pg"></span><button type="button" id="next">Next</button></div>
      <div class="x-cap" id="captbl"></div>
    </section>

    <div class="x-lower">
      <section class="x-card">
        <h3>How to read this explorer</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><b>Documents</b> are patent applications and grants, not drugs or products. The export holds about one document per invention (3,262 distinct priority filings).</li>
          <li><b>Legal status</b> groups Lens.org statuses: granted or in force; pending; discontinued, expired or inactive; other.</li>
          <li><b>Targets and strategies</b> are keyword flags on titles and abstracts (for example “bispecific”, “combination”, “subcutaneous”). They are approximate.</li>
          <li><b>Applicant type</b> comes from the cleaned 2024 applicant table; hospitals and institutes listed as commercial were moved to academic / research.</li>
          <li><b>Class</b> in the tables compares first and last filing year with the last year selected: continuant (still filing), newcomer (first filing in that year), terminator (stopped earlier), transient (one year only).</li>
          <li><b>Centrality</b> comes from the co-applicant network of the full dataset.</li>
          <li>Years after 2021 are incomplete. Inventor names are not disambiguated.</li>
        </ul>
      </section>
      <section class="x-card">
        <h3>Data and code</h3>
        <p class="x-sub" style="margin:0">Patent records from <a href="https://www.lens.org">Lens.org</a>, exported 28 January 2024 with a search on checkpoint drug names, targets and brand names.</p>
        <div style="font-size:14px;margin-top:10px">Code and processed data: <a href="https://github.com/descartesmbogning/immune-checkpoint-patent-explorer">github.com/descartesmbogning/immune-checkpoint-patent-explorer</a></div>
        <h3 style="margin-top:18px">Method</h3>
        <div class="x-cite">The approach follows Mbogning Fonkou MD et al., <i>Leveraging machine learning and big data techniques to map the global patent landscape of phage therapy</i>, Nature Biotechnology (2024). <a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02493-9">doi:10.1038/s41587-024-02493-9</a></div>
        <p style="font-size:14px;margin:14px 0 0">Want a patent landscape like this for your field? <a href="https://cal.com/cognosx">Book a call with CognosX</a>.</p>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
fetch('files/immune-checkpoint/explorer_data.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(D=>{
const C = {c:['#C98000','#2F64B5','#C24A2E','#0E9A7E','#8A4FB0'],neutral:'#9a9890',ink:'#141414',muted:'#5c5c5c',grid:'#e6e3dd',soft:'#f7f5f0',
  seq:['#ffffff','#fbe9c7','#f6cf85','#eeb043','#d98e0b','#b87500','#8f5a00','#5f3c00']};
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const M = D.meta, P = D.p, N = P.id.length;
const LASTC = M.last_complete_year, SHARE0 = 2014;
const STATUS_COL = {'Granted / in force':C.c[3],'Pending application':C.c[0],'Discontinued / expired':C.c[2],'Other / unknown':C.neutral};
const TYPE_COL = {'Commercial':C.c[0],'Academic / research':C.c[1],'Individual':C.c[4],'Government':C.c[3],'Unknown':C.neutral};
const OFFICE_COL = {'National office':C.c[0],'International (PCT)':C.c[1],'Regional office':C.c[3]};
const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString('en'), pc = x => isFinite(x) ? Math.round(x)+'%' : '–';
const YMIN = Math.min(...P.y), YMAX = Math.max(...P.y);
const narrow = () => window.innerWidth < 640;
const CN = D.ctys.name.indexOf('China');
const TGT_COMB = M.strategies.indexOf('Combination therapy');
let S = {y0:2010, y1:YMAX, s:-1, t:-1, g:-1, a:-1, tab:'orgs', page:0, sortKey:null, sortDir:-1, q:''};

// ---------- controls
function opts(el, labels, allLabel){ el.innerHTML = `<option value="-1">${allLabel}</option>` + labels.map((l,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${l}</option>`).join(''); }
function fillControls(){
  const ys = []; for(let y=YMIN;y<=YMAX;y++) ys.push(y);
  $('y0').innerHTML = ys.map(y=>`<option${y===S.y0?' selected':''}>${y}</option>`).join('');
  $('y1').innerHTML = ys.map(y=>`<option${y===S.y1?' selected':''}>${y}</option>`).join('');
  opts($('fs'), M.statuses, 'All'); opts($('ft'), M.targets, 'All'); opts($('fg'), M.strategies, 'All'); opts($('fa'), M.types, 'All');
  const on = (id,k,num=true) => $(id).onchange = e => { S[k] = +e.target.value; if(S.y0>S.y1){ if(k==='y0') S.y1=S.y0; else S.y0=S.y1; $('y0').value=S.y0; $('y1').value=S.y1; } S.page=0; render(); };
  on('y0','y0'); on('y1','y1'); on('fs','s'); on('ft','t'); on('fg','g'); on('fa','a');
  $('reset').onclick = () => { S = {...S, y0:2010, y1:YMAX, s:-1, t:-1, g:-1, a:-1, page:0, q:''}; $('q').value=''; ['fs','ft','fg','fa'].forEach(i=>$(i).value=-1); $('y0').value=S.y0; $('y1').value=S.y1; render(); };
  document.querySelectorAll('.x-seg button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.tab=b.dataset.t; S.page=0; S.sortKey=null; S.sortDir=-1;
    document.querySelectorAll('.x-seg button').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x===b)); table(); });
  $('q').oninput = e => { S.q = e.target.value.toLowerCase(); S.page=0; table(); };
  $('prev').onclick = () => { if(S.page>0){S.page--; table();} };
  $('next').onclick = () => { S.page++; table(); };
  $('csv').onclick = downloadCSV;
}

// ---------- filtering
const ORG_TYPE = D.orgs.type;
function selected(){
  const out = [];
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const y = P.y[i];
    if(y<S.y0 || y>S.y1) continue;
    if(S.s>=0 && P.s[i]!==S.s) continue;
    if(S.t>=0 && !(P.tg[i] & (1<<S.t))) continue;
    if(S.g>=0 && !(P.st[i] & (1<<S.g))) continue;
    if(S.a>=0 && !P.a[i].some(o=>ORG_TYPE[o]===S.a)) continue;
    out.push(i);
  }
  return out;
}

// ---------- plotting helpers
const CFG = {displaylogo:false, responsive:true, modeBarButtonsToRemove:['lasso2d','select2d','autoScale2d','toggleSpikelines']};
function base(extra={}){ return Object.assign({font:{family:'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif',size:12.5,color:C.ink},paper_bgcolor:'#fff',plot_bgcolor:'#fff',
  margin:{l:50,r:14,t:10,b:44},hoverlabel:{bgcolor:'#fff',bordercolor:C.grid,font:{color:C.ink}},
  xaxis:{gridcolor:C.grid,linecolor:C.muted,zeroline:false,automargin:true},yaxis:{gridcolor:C.grid,linecolor:C.muted,zeroline:false,automargin:true},
  legend:LEG()}, extra, narrow()?{margin:Object.assign({l:10,r:10,t:10,b:40},extra.margin||{},{b:Math.max(110,(extra.margin||{}).b||0)}),legend:LEG()}:{}); }
function LEG(y=1.12){ return narrow() ? {orientation:'h',x:0,y:-0.22,yanchor:'top',font:{size:11},traceorder:'normal'} : {orientation:'h',x:0,y,font:{size:11.5},traceorder:'normal'}; }
function shade(lo){ return S.y1>LASTC ? [{type:'rect',xref:'x',yref:'paper',x0:LASTC+0.5,x1:Math.max(S.y1,LASTC+1)+0.5,y0:0,y1:1,fillcolor:C.soft,line:{width:0},layer:'below'}] : []; }
function shadeNote(){ return S.y1>LASTC ? [{xref:'x',yref:'paper',x:LASTC+0.6,y:1,xanchor:'left',yanchor:'top',text:'Incomplete',showarrow:false,font:{size:10.5,color:C.muted}}] : []; }
function plot(id, data, layout){ Plotly.react(id, data, layout, CFG); }
function empty(id){ plot(id, [], base({xaxis:{visible:false},yaxis:{visible:false},annotations:[{text:'No documents match these filters.',showarrow:false,font:{color:C.muted}}]})); }
const range = (a,b) => { const r=[]; for(let i=a;i<=b;i++) r.push(i); return r; };
const countBy = (ids, fn) => { const m = new Map(); ids.forEach(i => fn(i).forEach(k => m.set(k,(m.get(k)||0)+1))); return m; };
const scope = () => `${fmt(SEL.length)} documents, ${S.y0}–${S.y1}`;
let SEL = [];

// ---------- 0. KPIs and status
function kpis(){
  const share = (y0,y1) => { const ids = SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]>=y0&&P.y[i]<=y1); return ids.length>=20 ? 100*ids.filter(i=>P.k[i].includes(CN)).length/ids.length : NaN; };
  const now = share(2020,2021), then = share(2015,2016);
  $('k1').textContent = pc(now); $('k1n').textContent = isFinite(then) ? `${pc(then)} in 2015–16` : 'too few documents in 2015–16';
  $('k2').textContent = fmt(SEL.length); $('k2n').textContent = `of ${fmt(N)} in total, ${S.y0}–${S.y1}`;
  const g = SEL.filter(i=>P.s[i]===0).length, pend = SEL.filter(i=>P.s[i]===1).length;
  $('k3').textContent = SEL.length ? pc(100*g/SEL.length) : '–'; $('k3n').textContent = SEL.length ? `${pc(100*pend/SEL.length)} still pending` : '';
  const comb = SEL.filter(i=>P.st[i]&(1<<TGT_COMB)).length;
  $('k4').textContent = SEL.length ? pc(100*comb/SEL.length) : '–'; $('k4n').textContent = 'keyword label on title and abstract';
  $('status').textContent = `${fmt(SEL.length)} of ${fmt(N)} documents` + (S.y1>LASTC ? ` · years after ${LASTC} incomplete` : '');
}

// ---------- 1. Growth
function vGrowth(){
  if(!SEL.length) return empty('c1');
  const yrs = range(S.y0,S.y1);
  const data = M.statuses.map((st,si)=>({type:'bar',name:st,x:yrs,y:yrs.map(y=>SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&P.s[i]===si).length),marker:{color:STATUS_COL[st]},
    hovertemplate:`%{x}: %{y} ${st.toLowerCase()}<extra></extra>`}));
  plot('c1', data, base({barmode:'stack',bargap:0.15,shapes:shade(),annotations:shadeNote(),yaxis:{title:{text:'Documents'},gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true},xaxis:{title:{text:narrow()?'':'Application year'},dtick:narrow()?4:2,automargin:true}}));
  const comp = SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]<=LASTC), byY = countBy(comp, i=>[P.y[i]]);
  let peak = null; byY.forEach((v,k)=>{ if(!peak||v>peak[1]) peak=[k,v]; });
  $('cap1').textContent = `Source: Lens.org export of ${M.data_date}. ${scope()}.` + (peak ? ` Busiest complete year: ${peak[0]} (${fmt(peak[1])} documents).` : '');
}

// ---------- 2. Organisations
function vOrgs(){
  if(!SEL.length){ empty('c2'); empty('c3'); return; }
  const m = countBy(SEL, i=>P.a[i].filter(o=>D.orgs.type[o]!==2));     // 2 = Individual
  const top = [...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,15).reverse();
  const short = s => { const L = narrow()?24:34; return s.length>L ? s.slice(0,L-2)+'…' : s; };
  const data = M.types.map((t,ti)=>{ const r = top.filter(([o])=>D.orgs.type[o]===ti); return {type:'bar',orientation:'h',name:t,
    y:r.map(([o])=>short(D.orgs.name[o])),x:r.map(([,v])=>v),marker:{color:TYPE_COL[t]},customdata:r.map(([o])=>[D.orgs.name[o],D.orgs.country[o]]),
    hovertemplate:'%{customdata[0]} (%{customdata[1]}): %{x} documents<extra></extra>'}; }).filter(d=>d.x.length);
  plot('c2', data, base({barmode:'stack',margin:{l:10,r:14,t:30,b:40},xaxis:{title:{text:'Documents'},gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true},
    yaxis:{categoryorder:'array',categoryarray:top.map(([o])=>short(D.orgs.name[o])),automargin:true,tickfont:{size:narrow()?10.5:11.5}},legend:LEG(1.08)}));
  if(top.length) $('cap2').textContent = `Most active: ${D.orgs.name[top[top.length-1][0]]} (${top[top.length-1][1]} documents). ${scope()}. Individuals are left out of this ranking.`;

  const yrs = range(Math.max(SHARE0,S.y0),S.y1);
  const tot = countBy(SEL, i=>[P.y[i]]);
  const data2 = M.types.filter(t=>t!=='Unknown').map(t=>{ const ti = M.types.indexOf(t);
    return {type:'scatter',mode:'lines+markers',name:t,x:yrs,y:yrs.map(y=>{ const n=tot.get(y)||0; if(n<20) return null;
      return 100*SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&P.a[i].some(o=>D.orgs.type[o]===ti)).length/n; }),line:{color:TYPE_COL[t],width:2.2},marker:{size:6},
      hovertemplate:`%{x}: %{y:.0f}% ${t.toLowerCase()}<extra></extra>`}; });
  plot('c3', data2, base({shapes:shade(),annotations:shadeNote(),yaxis:{title:{text:'Share of documents (%)'},gridcolor:C.grid,rangemode:'tozero',automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:2,gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true}}));
  $('cap3').textContent = `Years with fewer than 20 documents are not shown. ${scope()}.`;
}

// ---------- 3. Countries
function vCountries(){
  if(!SEL.length){ empty('c4'); empty('c5'); return; }
  const m = countBy(SEL, i=>P.k[i]);
  const rows = [...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  plot('c4', [{type:'choropleth',locations:rows.map(([c])=>D.ctys.iso3[c]),z:rows.map(([,v])=>v),text:rows.map(([c])=>D.ctys.name[c]),
    colorscale:C.seq.slice(1).map((c,i,a)=>[i/(a.length-1),c]),marker:{line:{color:'#fff',width:0.5}},colorbar:{thickness:10,len:0.6,title:{text:'Docs',font:{size:11}}},
    hovertemplate:'%{text}: %{z} documents<extra></extra>'}],
    base({margin:{l:0,r:0,t:0,b:0},geo:{projection:{type:'natural earth'},showframe:false,showcoastlines:false,showcountries:true,countrycolor:C.grid,landcolor:C.soft,bgcolor:'#fff'}}));
  $('cap4').textContent = rows.length>=2 ? `${D.ctys.name[rows[0][0]]} (${fmt(rows[0][1])}) and ${D.ctys.name[rows[1][0]]} (${fmt(rows[1][1])}) lead. ${scope()}.` : scope();

  const top5 = rows.slice(0,5).map(([c])=>c), yrs = range(Math.max(SHARE0,S.y0),S.y1), tot = countBy(SEL, i=>[P.y[i]]);
  const data = top5.map((c,ci)=>({type:'scatter',mode:'lines+markers',name:D.ctys.name[c],x:yrs,y:yrs.map(y=>{ const n=tot.get(y)||0; if(n<20) return null;
    return 100*SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&P.k[i].includes(c)).length/n; }),line:{color:C.c[ci],width:2.2},marker:{size:6},hovertemplate:`%{x}: %{y:.0f}% ${D.ctys.name[c]}<extra></extra>`}));
  plot('c5', data, base({shapes:shade(),annotations:shadeNote(),yaxis:{title:{text:'Share of documents (%)'},gridcolor:C.grid,rangemode:'tozero',automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:2,gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true}}));
  $('cap5').textContent = `Years with fewer than 20 documents are not shown. ${scope()}.`;
}

// ---------- 4. Technologies
function vTech(){
  if(!SEL.length){ ['c6','c7','c8'].forEach(empty); return; }
  const yrs = range(Math.max(2010,S.y0),S.y1);
  const z = M.targets.map((t,ti)=>yrs.map(y=>SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&(P.tg[i]&(1<<ti))).length));
  const keep = M.targets.map((t,ti)=>z[ti].some(v=>v>0));
  const zz = z.filter((r,i)=>keep[i]), tt = M.targets.filter((t,i)=>keep[i]);
  plot('c6', [{type:'heatmap',x:yrs,y:tt,z:zz,colorscale:C.seq.map((c,i,a)=>[i/(a.length-1),c]),showscale:false,xgap:2,ygap:2,
    text:zz.map(r=>r.map(String)),texttemplate:narrow()?'':'%{text}',textfont:{size:10},hovertemplate:'%{y}, %{x}: %{z} documents<extra></extra>'}],
    base({margin:{l:10,r:10,t:6,b:36},yaxis:{autorange:'reversed',automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:narrow()?4:1,automargin:true}}));
  const tc = M.targets.map((t,ti)=>SEL.filter(i=>P.tg[i]&(1<<ti)).length);
  $('cap6').textContent = `PD-1 is named in ${fmt(tc[0])} documents; LAG-3, TIM-3 and TIGIT together in ${fmt(tc[3]+tc[4]+tc[5])}. A document naming two targets counts in both rows. ${scope()}.`;

  const sy = range(Math.max(SHARE0,S.y0),S.y1), tot = countBy(SEL, i=>[P.y[i]]);
  const sc = M.strategies.map((s,si)=>[si,SEL.filter(i=>P.st[i]&(1<<si)).length]).filter(([si])=>M.strategies[si]!=='Single agent / not stated').sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,5);
  plot('c7', sc.map(([si],k)=>({type:'scatter',mode:'lines+markers',name:M.strategies[si],x:sy,y:sy.map(y=>{ const n=tot.get(y)||0; if(n<20) return null;
    return 100*SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&(P.st[i]&(1<<si))).length/n; }),line:{color:C.c[k],width:2.2},marker:{size:6},hovertemplate:`%{x}: %{y:.0f}%<extra>${M.strategies[si]}</extra>`})),
    base({shapes:shade(),annotations:shadeNote(),legend:LEG(1.22),margin:{l:50,r:14,t:40,b:40},yaxis:{title:{text:'Share of documents (%)'},gridcolor:C.grid,rangemode:'tozero',automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:2,gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true}}));
  $('cap7').textContent = sc.length ? `${M.strategies[sc[0][0]]} is the most common strategy (${pc(100*sc[0][1]/SEL.length)} of documents). ${scope()}.` : scope();

  const tp = countBy(SEL, i=>[P.tp[i]]);
  const r = [...tp.entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);
  plot('c8', [{type:'bar',orientation:'h',y:r.map(([t])=>M.topics[t]),x:r.map(([,v])=>v),marker:{color:r.map(([t])=>M.topics[t]==='Unassigned'?C.neutral:C.c[0])},hovertemplate:'%{y}: %{x} documents<extra></extra>'}],
    base({margin:{l:10,r:14,t:6,b:40},showlegend:false,xaxis:{title:{text:'Documents'},gridcolor:C.grid,nticks:4,automargin:true},yaxis:{automargin:true,tickfont:{size:11}}}));
  $('cap8').textContent = scope()+'.';
}

// ---------- 5. Offices
function vOffices(){
  if(!SEL.length){ empty('c9'); empty('c10'); return; }
  const m = countBy(SEL, i=>[P.j[i]]), r = [...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  const top = r.slice(0,15).reverse();
  const types = ['National office','International (PCT)','Regional office'];
  plot('c9', types.map(t=>{ const rr = top.filter(([j])=>D.jur.type[j]===t); return {type:'bar',orientation:'h',name:t,y:rr.map(([j])=>D.jur.name[j]),x:rr.map(([,v])=>v),marker:{color:OFFICE_COL[t]},hovertemplate:'%{y}: %{x} documents<extra></extra>'}; }).filter(d=>d.x.length),
    base({barmode:'stack',margin:{l:10,r:14,t:30,b:40},xaxis:{title:{text:'Documents'},gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true},yaxis:{categoryorder:'array',categoryarray:top.map(([j])=>D.jur.name[j]),automargin:true},legend:LEG(1.08)}));
  $('cap9').textContent = r.length ? `${D.jur.name[r[0][0]]} receives the most filings (${fmt(r[0][1])}). ${scope()}.` : scope();
  const t8 = r.slice(0,8).map(([j])=>j), yrs = range(Math.max(2010,S.y0),S.y1);
  const z = t8.map(j=>yrs.map(y=>SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===y&&P.j[i]===j).length));
  plot('c10', [{type:'heatmap',x:yrs,y:t8.map(j=>D.jur.name[j]),z,colorscale:C.seq.map((c,i,a)=>[i/(a.length-1),c]),showscale:false,xgap:2,ygap:2,
    text:z.map(rr=>rr.map(String)),texttemplate:narrow()?'':'%{text}',textfont:{size:10},hovertemplate:'%{y}, %{x}: %{z} documents<extra></extra>'}],
    base({margin:{l:10,r:10,t:6,b:36},yaxis:{autorange:'reversed',automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:narrow()?4:2,automargin:true}}));
  $('cap10').textContent = scope()+'.';
}

// ---------- 6. Science links
function vScience(){
  if(!SEL.length){ empty('c11'); empty('c12'); return; }
  const yrs = range(Math.max(SHARE0,S.y0),S.y1);
  const y = yrs.map(yy=>{ const ids = SEL.filter(i=>P.y[i]===yy); return ids.length>=20 ? 100*ids.filter(i=>P.n[i]>0).length/ids.length : null; });
  plot('c11', [{type:'scatter',mode:'lines+markers',x:yrs,y,line:{color:C.c[1],width:2.2},marker:{size:6},hovertemplate:'%{x}: %{y:.0f}% cite papers<extra></extra>'}],
    base({showlegend:false,shapes:shade(),annotations:shadeNote(),yaxis:{title:{text:'Documents citing papers (%)'},range:[0,100],gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true},xaxis:{dtick:2,gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true}}));
  const all = SEL.filter(i=>P.n[i]>0).length;
  $('cap11').textContent = `${pc(100*all/SEL.length)} of selected documents cite at least one research paper. ${scope()}.`;
  const bins = [['None',0,0],['1–5',1,5],['6–20',6,20],['21–50',21,50],['More than 50',51,1e9]];
  plot('c12', [{type:'bar',x:bins.map(b=>b[0]),y:bins.map(([,a,b])=>SEL.filter(i=>P.n[i]>=a&&P.n[i]<=b).length),marker:{color:C.c[0]},hovertemplate:'%{x}: %{y} documents<extra></extra>'}],
    base({showlegend:false,yaxis:{title:{text:'Documents'},gridcolor:C.grid,automargin:true},xaxis:{title:{text:'Research papers cited'},automargin:true}}));
  $('cap12').textContent = scope()+'.';
}

// ---------- 7. Tables
const lens = (q) => 'https://www.lens.org/lens/search/patent/list?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
function cls(f,l){ if(l===S.y1) return f===S.y1 ? 'Newcomer' : 'Continuant'; return f===l ? 'Transient' : 'Terminator'; }
function entityRows(getKeys, label){
  const m = new Map();
  SEL.forEach(i=>getKeys(i).forEach(k=>{ let e = m.get(k); if(!e){ e={n:0,g:0,c:0,f:9999,l:0}; m.set(k,e); }
    e.n++; if(P.s[i]===0) e.g++; e.c+=P.c[i]; e.f=Math.min(e.f,P.y[i]); e.l=Math.max(e.l,P.y[i]); }));
  return [...m.entries()].map(([k,e])=>({k, Documents:e.n, Granted:e.g, Citations:e.c, 'First year':e.f, 'Last year':e.l, Class:cls(e.f,e.l), 'Share (%)':+(100*e.n/Math.max(SEL.length,1)).toFixed(2)}));
}
function tableData(){
  if(S.tab==='orgs') return {cols:['Organisation','Country','Type','Documents','Granted','Citations','First year','Last year','Class','Share (%)','Degree','Betweenness'],
    rows: entityRows(i=>P.a[i].filter(o=>D.orgs.type[o]!==2)).map(r=>({Organisation:D.orgs.name[r.k],Country:D.orgs.country[r.k],Type:M.types[D.orgs.type[r.k]],...r,Degree:D.orgs.deg[r.k],Betweenness:D.orgs.btw[r.k]})),
    link: r => lens(`applicant.name:"${r.Organisation}"`), linkCol:'Organisation'};
  if(S.tab==='ctys') return {cols:['Country','Region','Documents','Granted','Citations','First year','Last year','Class','Share (%)','Degree','Betweenness'],
    rows: entityRows(i=>P.k[i]).map(r=>({Country:D.ctys.name[r.k],Region:D.ctys.region[r.k],...r,Degree:D.ctys.deg[r.k],Betweenness:D.ctys.btw[r.k]}))};
  if(S.tab==='invs') return {cols:['Inventor','Documents','Granted','Citations','First year','Last year','Class','Share (%)'],
    rows: entityRows(i=>P.i[i]).map(r=>({Inventor:D.invs[r.k],...r})), link: r => lens(`inventor.name:"${r.Inventor}"`), linkCol:'Inventor'};
  return {cols:['Title','Year','Office','Status','Cited by patents','Papers cited','Targets','Strategies'],
    rows: SEL.map(i=>({k:i,Title:P.t[i],Year:P.y[i],Office:D.jur.code[P.j[i]],Status:M.statuses[P.s[i]],'Cited by patents':P.c[i],'Papers cited':P.n[i],
      Targets:M.targets.filter((t,ti)=>P.tg[i]&(1<<ti)).join(', ')||'Not stated',Strategies:M.strategies.filter((t,ti)=>P.st[i]&(1<<ti)).join(', ')})),
    link: r => 'https://lens.org/'+P.id[r.k], linkCol:'Title', defaultSort:'Cited by patents'};
}
let TBL = null;
function table(){
  TBL = tableData();
  $('inv-warn').hidden = S.tab!=='invs';
  let rows = TBL.rows;
  if(S.q) rows = rows.filter(r=>TBL.cols.some(c=>String(r[c]).toLowerCase().includes(S.q)));
  const key = S.sortKey && TBL.cols.includes(S.sortKey) ? S.sortKey : (TBL.defaultSort||'Documents');
  rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>{ const x=a[key], y=b[key]; return (typeof x==='number' ? x-y : String(x).localeCompare(String(y)))*S.sortDir; });
  TBL.view = rows;
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length/15)); S.page = Math.min(S.page, pages-1);
  const isNum = c => rows.length && typeof rows[0][c]==='number';
  const head = '<thead><tr>'+TBL.cols.map(c=>`<th class="${isNum(c)?'num':''}" data-c="${esc(c)}" ${c===key?`aria-sort="${S.sortDir>0?'ascending':'descending'}"`:''}>${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead>';
  const body = '<tbody>'+rows.slice(S.page*15,S.page*15+15).map(r=>'<tr>'+TBL.cols.map(c=>{ const v = r[c];
    if(c===TBL.linkCol) return `<td><a href="${TBL.link(r)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(v)}</a></td>`;
    return `<td class="${typeof v==='number'?'num':''}">${typeof v==='number' && !String(c).includes('year') && c!=='Year' ? (Number.isInteger(v)?fmt(v):v) : esc(v)}</td>`; }).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody>';
  $('tbl').innerHTML = head + (rows.length ? body : `<tbody><tr><td colspan="${TBL.cols.length}">No rows match.</td></tr></tbody>`);
  $('tbl').querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th=>th.onclick=()=>{ const c=th.dataset.c; if(S.sortKey===c) S.sortDir*=-1; else { S.sortKey=c; S.sortDir = (rows.length&&typeof rows[0][c]==='number')?-1:1; } table(); });
  $('pg').textContent = `${fmt(rows.length)} rows · page ${S.page+1} of ${pages}`;
  $('prev').disabled = S.page===0; $('next').disabled = S.page>=pages-1;
  $('captbl').textContent = `Class compares first and last filing year with ${S.y1}. Centrality comes from the co-applicant network of the full dataset. ${scope()}.`;
}
function downloadCSV(){
  if(!TBL || !TBL.view) return;
  const q = v => /[",\n]/.test(String(v)) ? `"${String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')}"` : v;
  const txt = [TBL.cols.join(','), ...TBL.view.map(r=>TBL.cols.map(c=>q(r[c]??'')).join(','))].join('\n');
  const u = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([txt],{type:'text/csv'})); const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href=u; a.download=`immune_checkpoint_${S.tab}_${S.y0}-${S.y1}.csv`; a.click(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),500);
}

function render(){ SEL = selected(); kpis(); vGrowth(); vOrgs(); vCountries(); vTech(); vOffices(); vScience(); table(); }
fillControls(); render();
let lastN = narrow(), tmr; window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(tmr); tmr=setTimeout(()=>{ if(narrow()!==lastN){ lastN=narrow(); render(); } },200);});
}).catch(e=>{ const el=document.getElementById('status'); if(el) el.textContent='Could not load the data. Please refresh the page.'; console.error(e); });
</script>

```
